svg.text: GDN solve — 3 implementations stacked per thread (Perfetto style aggregate)

Each thread (p0–p3 HVX producers + CONS HMX consumer) shows 3 rows: (0) SHIP u8i8 · (1) W16_N8 ARES · (2) pure-HMX — same-class stages share a colour, so the per-route stage MIX is comparable down each thread group.

⚠ SINGLE-REP TRACE — read STAGE STRUCTURE ONLY (MM unified to consumer-only). Do NOT read per-thread utilization/occupancy off this figure — it is trace-perturbed. Authoritative steady-state util/occupancy = Agent/current/perf_3impl_cron82kqie.txt (SHIP 1.892M / ARES 2.506M / pure-HMX 1.259M; HVX-util 96%/94%/83%).
shared absolute domain-cycle axis (each impl 0-based; trace-perturbed single rep) →
MM — 64³ matmul · HMX — CONS row ONLY (all 3 impls)
Legend index: (0)=SHIP u8i8 1.925M · (1)=W16_N8 ARES 2.55M · (2)=pure-HMX 1.258M (32-head total VTCM-only production walls).

HONESTY: each route uses its own taxonomy (SHIP/ARES = HVX fwd-subst+off-diag merge with DIAG/REQ/EFF/DEPACK; pure-HMX = Taylor(3), NO DIAG); only same-class colours are comparable. pure-HMX is a different harness — the shared cyc axis is a visual aid, cross-harness per-thread occupancy is NOT hard-comparable, read the stage MIX only.
